cases.title: Marianne's Disappearance
cases.shortDesc: Senior museum curator Marianne Reed vanishes after an evening shift on July 27, 2024.
cases.briefingSummary: On July 27, 2024 at 21:00, Archival Conservator David Reed contacted police to report that his wife, Marianne Reed, had failed to return home from the Grand Meridian Museum. According to David, Marianne's routine rarely deviates without prior notice, though there had been recent tension surrounding her curatorial discoveries at work. Examine the physical scene, logs, and timelines across all four channels—every action costs 5 minutes of your 30-minute critical window.

cases.title: The Ashworth Will
cases.shortDesc: Matriarch Eleanor Ashworth vanishes during a stormy family dinner hours before signing a revised inheritance trust.
cases.briefingSummary: During an autumn storm on October 14, 2024, 64-year-old matriarch Eleanor Ashworth gathered her family at Ashworth Manor to announce a revised estate trust removing one beneficiary at midnight. At 20:15, she entered the West Library to finalize the papers and vanished. Below the manor lies a sealed Subterranean Wine Cellar equipped with an automated CO2 fire-suppression system—and the pressure seal has just been triggered.
